title: Shadow Falls
description:
Shadow Falls is an emotionally charged horror game where a grieving mother ventures into a forest to scatter her son's ashes, only to be drawn to an isolated farmhouse where strange things start to unfold. As she uncovers the secrets of the house and the forest, she discovers that death might not be the end and is faced with a harrowing choice that requires the ultimate sacrifice. Her journey explores the depths of a mother's unconditional love and the lengths she will go to for her child, all while battling malevolent entities determined to preserve the natural order and prevent her from reuniting with her son.

Traverse the breathtaking landscapes of Shadow Falls National Park, from the dense forest to the enigmatic old farmhouse and more.

 

Gather clues and unravel puzzles and riddles to advance your quest and uncover the secrets of Shadow Falls.

 

 Collect notes that delve into the rich backstory of Shadow Falls and its enigmatic residents.

 

Acquire a unique collection of artifacts essential for conducting the ultimate séance.

Engage with NPCs, encountering both allies and adversaries along your journey
description_short: Shadow Falls is a first-person horror game, where you explore a mysterious farmhouse deep in the forest, solving eerie puzzles and uncovering secrets that reveal the thin veil between the world of the living and the dead. Delve deeper and uncover the sinister forces that led you here.
